visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of thin, golden-brown almond crackers piled on a blue plate. The crackers are covered in overlapping almond slices, looking very crispy. The lighting is bright and warm, highlighting the texture of the baked nuts. (2) A male cook's hands are shown cracking a single egg into a small glass bowl on a wooden tabletop. He then pours a small amount of white sugar powder into the bowl and whisks it vigorously with a metal fork until the mixture is uniform and yellow. (3) The cook holds a circular, translucent piece of Vietnamese rice paper and uses black scissors to cut it neatly in half. He is wearing a clean white chef's coat, and the background shows a light-colored brick wall. (4) The cook places one half of the rice paper onto a black baking tray lined with white parchment paper. He uses a yellow silicone brush to spread a thin, even layer of the egg wash over the rough surface of the rice paper. (5) A second piece of rice paper is pressed on top of the first, and another layer of egg wash is applied. The cook then uses his gloved hand to sprinkle a generous amount of sliced almonds over the wet surface, ensuring full coverage. (6) The tray is slid into a small electric oven where the interior light is on. The camera captures the crackers as they begin to bake and turn golden. The timer and temperature settings are displayed as text overlays. (7) Finally, the cook removes the tray and holds up a finished cracker, snapping it in half to demonstrate its extreme brittleness. The camera zooms in on the fractured edge, showcasing the multi-layered, crunchy structure of the snack.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, upbeat acoustic guitar strumming and a steady percussion beat. A friendly male voice introduces the recipe for 'Almond Rice Paper Crackers' with a clear, energetic tone. (2) A sharp, percussive sound of an egg shell cracking is heard, followed by the metallic clinking of a fork against glass as the narrator explains the mixing of egg and sugar. (3) The rhythmic snip-snip of scissors cutting through crisp paper triggers a new phase. The narrator's speech rate remains steady as he describes resizing the Vietnamese rice paper. (4) Soft, sweeping brush sounds accompany the narrator's instructions on layering the egg wash and rice paper. The BGM maintains a consistent, happy tempo in the background. (5) The faint rustling of almond flakes being poured is audible. The speaker's volume is moderate and professional, guiding the viewer through the final assembly step before baking. (6) A distinct metallic click of an oven door closing is heard. The narrator provides specific technical details regarding the oven temperature and the duration needed for perfect crispness. (7) The video concludes with a loud, amplified crunch sound as a cracker is broken. The narrator lets out an appreciative 'mmm' and emphasizes how extremely crispy and delicious the result is.
